trimmingSuggestions.description: The initial montage of Nnamdi's luxurious lifestyle in Scene 2 could be shortened to maintain the video's momentum. While it establishes the allure of his new life, it slightly slows down the narrative pace.

The ritual scene in Scene 4 could be made more impactful by reducing its duration and focusing on key visuals and sound effects, creating a more chilling and concise depiction of the Cult Leader's violence.
